composite.name: messageHeader
composite.description: SBE framing header prepended to every message

composite.name: varDataEncoding
composite.description: Variable-length byte payload; length == 0 means absent

sbe:message.name: AppMessage
sbe:message.description: Application message sent by a client to the sequencer. The sequencer treats the payload as opaque bytes and stamps globalSeqNo + appSeqNo before re-publishing on the global stream.

sbe:message.name: SequencedMessage
sbe:message.description: Original AppMessage payload decorated with sequence numbers. globalSeqNo is monotonically increasing across all event types. appSeqNo is monotonically increasing per sourceSessionId.

field.name: globalSeqNo
field.description: Cluster-wide monotone sequence number; unique across all sources and event types.

field.name: sourceSessionId
field.description: Aeron Cluster client session ID of the originating client.

field.name: appSeqNo
field.description: Per-source monotone sequence number; resets when the session reconnects.

field.name: clusterTimestamp
field.description: Cluster-consensus timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

sbe:message.name: SourceConnected
sbe:message.description: A client opened a session with the sequencer cluster. Carries a globalSeqNo so subscribers maintain a complete ordered log.

sbe:message.name: SourceDisconnected
sbe:message.description: A client closed (or lost) its session with the sequencer cluster. Carries a globalSeqNo so subscribers maintain a complete ordered log.
